data.long_meaning: In Greek, Kyrstin derives from the Greek word 'kyrus' meaning 'lord'. The suffix 'stin' is derived from the Greek word 'stine', meaning 'woman' or 'lady'. Thus, Kyrstin means 'Lady, Lord's Powerful One'. In Christian tradition, this name is believed to represent the power and strength of God, making it a powerful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the power and strength of God.
data.etymology: Kyrstin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady, Lord's Powerful One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kyrstin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קירסטין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קירסטין הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם היווני Χρήστos (כריסטוס), שפירושו המשיח. השם קירסטין הוא גרסה נשית של השם כריסטוס, ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא המשיח' או 'נזר אלוהים'. השם קירסטין שימש את הנוצרים כחלופה לשם כריסטינה, שפירושו 'של המשיח'.

in_greek.name: Κυρστίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κυρστίν είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος Χρήστos (Χριστός), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο Χριστός' ή 'το δώρο του Θεού'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια του Χριστού και της σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Kyrstin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kyrstin originem habet in nomine Graeco Χρήστos (Christus), quod significat 'Deus est Christus' vel 'Dei donum'. In traditione christiana, nomen Kyrstin saepe coniungitur cum conceptu Christi et salvationis.

in_english.name: Kyrstin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kyrstin originates from the Greek name Χρήστos (Christos), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah'. As a feminine variant of Christopher, Kyrstin signifies a follower of Christ or a devoted Christian. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual devotion and connection to the divine.
